description_en: Configures the IP address whitelist and blacklist for a website
description_zh: 设置针对网站业务的黑名单和白名单IP
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo config-web-ip-set --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --black-list 59.49.0.0 --white-list 2.2.0.0/24 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigWebIpSet

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses and CIDR blocks in the blacklist. You can add up to 200 IP addresses or CIDR blocks to the blacklist
parameters.help_zh: 黑名单IP地址/地址段列表。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个黑名单IP地址/地址段
parameters.name: black_list

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses and CIDR blocks in the whitelist. You can add up to 200 IP addresses or CIDR blocks to the whitelist
parameters.help_zh: 白名单IP地址/地址段列表。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个白名单IP地址/地址段
parameters.name: white_list
